question:
select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/923ad5154c7ef0d351040c9ab26eaf1d3cf9a0830203daa65634af2d20b7aa6c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b7c0264b696d7c899a9ac04e12a0a2dd4293f23a342363cd96e5d28e977d776.png] 

__
 
• From 01 to 02 → The colored part is moving in the clockwise direction skipping 1 place
 
• From 02 to 03 → The colored part is moving in the clockwise direction skipping 2 places
 
• From 03 to 04 → The colored part is moving in the clockwise direction skipping 3 places
 
• From 04 to 05 → The colored part will move in the clockwise direction skipping 4 places

Thus, the correct answer is '**Option 02**__'.
